platform_findings.ubuntu: Native fixture selection passed and OpenObsidian showed the expected two-note vault. The cancellation click did not open a second picker on either same-SHA attempt. egui logged pointer-button events at [786,309], the prior Zenity button position, while xdotool reported the pointer at [36,51] over Open vault.
platform_findings.windows: Native fixture selection passed, but the cancellation click did not open a second picker on either same-SHA attempt. egui logged the press with hovered=false and release with hovered=true, so the button response did not report a click. UI Automation reported IsEnabled=false during polling while the final control inventory and app state reported the button enabled.
platform_findings.macos: Native folder-picker cancellation, vault/app-data snapshot checks, and Obsidian reopen passed on both attempts.

parallel_groups: All applicable native setup, build, and check groups passed on the exact source SHA.
correction: Attempt 20 separates pointer motion from the press, waits 250 ms before the press on Linux and the Windows screen-click fallback, and logs PointerMoved with PointerButton events.
execution_policy: No local tests, builds, formatters, linters, application launches, or executable validation were run. Validation evidence came from GitHub Actions.
